title: National Adaptation Fund For Climate Change
definition: A central sector scheme established in 2015 to support concrete adaptation activities in states and union territories that are particularly vulnerable to the adverse effects of climate change.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Environment/Climate Change) and GS Paper II (Governance/Policy). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding funding mechanisms and institutional hierarchy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Adaptation Fund For Climate Change.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC)
State Action Plan on Climate Change (SAPCC)
